title: A choice comes forward
use: A three-option quiz reveal, a chosen strategy, or one route brought into focus.
description: Three identical ceramic answer tiles sit on a recessed desk. One rises and tilts toward the viewer, then holds its selected state.
copy: Use --pos 0 for an unrevealed question poster. Seed modulo three selects the left, middle or right tile (0, 1 or 2). Bind that index explicitly to the native correct answer. Keep question, options and explanation native, and start this non-looping clip only on the answer beat.
metaphor: An authored video selection, not a clickable quiz or learner response. Tile dimensions do not encode confidence, votes, difficulty or correctness probabilities.
